newsitem.title: USA: Protection One sees flat Q1 dealer program.
newsitem.headline: Protection One sees flat Q1 dealer program.

text.p: Protection One Inc said results for the first fiscal quarter of 1997 in its dealer program are expected to be flat with levels posted in the fourth fiscal quarter of 1996.

"We do expect to see increases in that program in subsequent quarters," said chief financial officer John Hesse in a conference call to discuss results for the fourth fiscal quarter ended September 30.
Hesse attributed the anticipated flat results to traditional seasonal factors.
The dealer program generated more than 11,000 subscribers in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996.
Hesse also said the security company's future growth will be evenly divided between the dealer program and acquisitions.

Although the field of potential large acquisition candidates has diminished due to industry consolidation, Hesse noted that there are "thousands" of small and medium-sized companies that may be ripe for acquisition.
